        "tenderDescription-descriptionAppelOffres-eng": "Advance Procurement Notice\r\n\r\n \r\n\r\nData Center, (Modify design Built)\r\nNational Capital Region \r\n(with Security Requirements)\r\n\r\n\r\n\tPurpose of this Advance Procurement Notice\r\n\r\n\r\nThis is not a bid solicitation nor a request for proposals.\r\nIn the context of the major investments announced by the Government and to foster a proactive partnership with industry, DCC is issuing this Advance Procurement Notice (APN) to inform design-builders of an upcoming contract opportunity located within the National Capital Region (Ontario).\r\nThe purpose of this APN is to allow design-builders to assess their capacity and interest in participating, and to prepare adequately for the potential solicitation process, notably by initiating any necessary steps.\r\nThis is a preliminary notice regarding a potential contract, which includes security requirements. The purpose of this APN is to allow interested design-builders to initiate, if required, the sponsorship process to obtain the necessary clearances or security clearances (if applicable).\r\nPlease note that there is no guarantee that this contract will proceed or that security clearances will be granted within the anticipated timelines or at all as part of the sponsorship process.\r\nPlease note that this project may include Indigenous businesses participation component in accordance with the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business (PSIB).\r\n\r\n\r\n\tDescription of the Project and Services\r\n\r\n\r\nIt is anticipated that the following solicitation will proceed as noted in the table below. This is conditional on the contract receiving approval to proceed\r\n\r\nProject Number: WA257004\r\nContract Number: 88262\r\nTitle: Data Center NCR\r\nApproximate Estimate: 1.5B to 1.85B\r\nAnticipated Posting: Winter 2027\r\n\r\nDescription:\r\nTo increase its capacity in supporting the mid to long-term objectives related to operations, security, and technology modernization, the Government of Canada is planning to design and construction a data center facility within the National Capital Region.\r\nThis Data center of 60 MW will enable the onboarding of next-generation capabilities with tailored mechanical and electrical configurations to meet distinct technology requirements throughout the facility. The proposed data centre facility will also include a small office space and a shipping and receiving area.\r\n\r\nThe estimated cost of the proposed Modified Design-Build (MDB) Contract exceeds $1.5 to 1.85B.\r\n\r\nIt is anticipated that this solicitation will be initiated in Winter 2027.  This is conditional on receiving approval to proceed by the Government of Canada.\r\n\r\n\r\n\tContract Award and Anticipated Security Requirements\r\n\r\n\r\nTo be eligible for contract award, a proponent will be required to, among other things, actively hold or obtain all required security clearance(s) prior to the date of the award, as further detailed in the solicitation documents.\r\nAs of the date of posting of this Advance Procurement Notice, the required security clearance(s) are anticipated to be:\r\n\r\n\r\n\tfor design-builders: a valid Facility Security Clearance (FSC).\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\n\t Industrial Security Program Sponsorship \r\n\r\n\r\nDefence Construction Canada (DCC) is providing design-builders early access to the security clearance application process through sponsorship under its Industrial Security Program (ISP). Accordingly, design-builders that intend to submit a proposal for this project and that do not actively hold the above identified security clearance(s) should begin forthwith the security clearance application process by applying through DCC’s ISP.\r\nUnder this program, DCC may, at its entire discretion, provide preliminary assistance to all the potential proponents with their respective security clearance sponsorship process.\r\nTo begin the security clearance sponsorship process, please submit a sponsorship request application to DCC by following the steps identified on DCC’s website at: https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/security-requirements.\r\nIn their sponsorship request application to DCC, design-builders are asked to quote the following information, among other things:\r\n\r\n\r\n\t\r\n\tAdvance Procurement Notice (APN) number, as identified in Section 2 of this APN; and\r\n\t\r\n\t\r\n\tLevel of clearance requested to be sponsored, as identified in Section 3 of this APN.\r\n\t\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\n\tSponsorship Process\r\n\r\n\r\nUpon receipt, DCC will review the sponsorship request application and will communicate directly with the design-builders to provide assistance for the completion of the sponsorship request packages.\r\nOnce DCC has determined, at its entire discretion, that a design-builders\r\n\r\n\r\n\thas started the sponsorship process prior to the solicitation being advertised on MERX,\r\n\thas met all the material requirements of the sponsorship request package prior to the closing date indicated in the solicitation, and\r\n\thas submitted a proposal.\r\n\r\n\r\n \r\n\r\nDCC will send the documents to the Public Services and Procurement Canada’s (PSPC) Contract Security Program (CSP).\r\nNote – Design-Builder that do not submit a proposal will not be able to attain clearance through this sponsorship process.\r\n\r\nFollowing receipt of the sponsorship request package, the CSP will communicate directly with the proponent regarding any further steps or actions to be undertaken or the status of the sponsorship request package processing. At such time, the proponent will need to promptly cooperate with CSP to ensure that the process is completed as soon as possible.\r\n\r\n\r\n\tQuestions\r\n\r\n\r\nAny questions pertaining to the sponsoring process through the ISP can be addressed to:\r\nTelephone Number: (613) 998-8974; or\r\nEmail address: ISP.Sponsorship@dcc-cdc.gc.ca\r\n\r\n \r\n\r\nAny questions relating to this Advance Procurement Notice can be addressed to:\r\nStephanie Tanguay\r\nRegional service line leader, Contract services\r\nDefence Construction Canada\r\n613-715-4626\r\nstephanie.tanguay@dcc-cdc.gc.ca\r\n\r\n\r\n\tDisclaimer\r\n\r\n\r\nDCC is only providing assistance, at its entire discretion, for the above stated sponsorship process and does not provide any representations or guarantees that a sponsorship request package or a security clearance application forwarded by DCC to the CSP will be successful or result in the granting of the requested security clearance(s) by the CSP. At all times, the processing of a sponsorship request package or a security clearance application is subject to the respective terms, conditions, and timelines of DCC’s ISP sponsorship process and the CSP security clearance granting process. By applying to either of the aforementioned processes, the proponent agrees to bear any fees and risks associated with: (i) the completeness or accuracy, or lack thereof, of its application or related documents submitted under or in connection with either said processes, and (ii) the timeliness, or lack thereof, of any processing or granting of security clearance(s) under or in connection with either said processes. Notwithstanding anything else stated above, DCC shall in no event be liable to the proponent for any direct, indirect, incidental, special, consequential, punitive or exemplary damages arising out or in connection with the above stated sponsorship process.Bidding and Documents are available on http://www.merx.com.  Fees may apply; See https://www.merx.com/public/pricing for more information.",
        "tenderDescription-descriptionAppelOffres-fra": "PRÉAVIS D’APPROVISIONNEMENT\r\n\r\nCENTRE DE DONNÉES (CONCEPTION-CONSTRUCTION MODIFIÉE)\r\nRÉGION DE LA CAPITALE NATIONALE\r\n(COMPREND DES EXIGENCES DE SÉCURITÉ)\r\n\r\n\r\n\tOBJECTIF DU PRÉSENT PRÉAVIS D’APPROVISIONNEMENT\r\n\r\n\r\nIl ne s’agit pas d’une demande de soumission ni d’une demande de proposition.\r\nDans le contexte des investissements majeurs annoncés par le gouvernement et afin de favoriser un partenariat proactif avec l’industrie, CDC diffuse le présent préavis d’approvisionnement (PA) afin d’informer les concepteurs-constructeurs d’un contrat à venir dans la Région de la capitale nationale.\r\nLe présent PA vise à permettre aux concepteurs-constructeurs d’évaluer leur capacité et leur intérêt à y participer, ainsi que de se préparer adéquatement en vue du processus de sollicitation.\r\nIl s’agit d’un avis préliminaire concernant un contrat potentiel qui comporte des exigences en matière de sécurité. Ce préavis vise à permettre aux concepteurs-constructeurs qui le souhaitent la possibilité d’entamer, au besoin, le processus de parrainage afin d’obtenir (si nécessaire) les habilitations ou les attestations de sécurité requises.\r\nVeuillez noter qu’il n’y a aucune garantie que ce contrat sera mis de l’avant ni que les attestations de sécurité seront accordées dans les délais anticipés ou seront même accordées dans le cadre du processus de parrainage.\r\nÀ noter que le projet pourrait comprendre un volet de participation pour entreprises autochtones conformément à la Stratégie d’approvisionnement auprès des entreprises autochtones (SAEA).\r\n \r\n\r\n\r\n\tDESCRIPTION DU PROJET ET DES SERVICES\r\n\r\n\r\nIl est prévu que la sollicitation suivante sera mise de l’avant comme indiqué dans le tableau ci-dessous. Ceci est conditionnel à l’approbation du contrat.\r\n\r\nNuméro de projet : WA257004\r\nNuméro de contrat : 82262\r\nTitre : Centre de données de la RNC\r\nEstimé approximatif : 1,5 G$ à 1,85 G$\r\nDate de publication prévue : hiver 2027\r\n\r\nDescription :\r\nAfin d’accroître sa capacité de soutenir les objectifs à moyen et à long terme liés aux opérations, à la sécurité et à la modernisation technologique, le gouvernement du Canada prévoit la conception et la construction d’un centre de données dans la Région de la capitale nationale.\r\nCe centre de données de 60 MW permettra l’intégration de capacités de nouvelle génération grâce à des configurations mécaniques et électriques adaptées aux différentes exigences technologiques dans l’ensemble de l’installation. Le centre de données proposé comprendra également un petit espace de bureau ainsi qu’une aire d’expédition et de réception.\r\n\r\nLe coût estimé du contrat de conception-construction modifiée (CCM) proposé dépasse 1,25 à 1,85 G$.\r\n\r\nIl est prévu que cette sollicitation sera lancée à l’hiver 2027.   Ceci est conditionnel à l’approbation par le gouvernement du Canada.\r\n\r\n\r\n\tExigences éventuelles en matière de sécurité et d’attribution du contrat\r\n\r\n\r\nPour être admissible à l’attribution d’un contrat, un soumissionnaire sera tenu, entre autres, détenir toute cote de sécurité requise avant la date de l’octroi du contrat, comme il sera indiqué en détail dans les documents de la sollicitation.\r\nÀ la date de publication du présent préavis d’approvisionnement, il est prévu que la cote de sécurité requise soit la suivante :\r\n\r\n\r\n\tpour les concepteurs-constructeurs : une attestation de sécurité d’installation (ASI) valide.\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\n\tParrainage dans le cadre du Programme de sécurité industrielle (PSI)\r\n\r\n\r\nConstruction de Défense Canada (CDC) offre aux concepteurs-constructeurs l’opportunité de se faire parrainer en vue d’obtenir une attestation de sécurité par l’entremise du Programme de sécurité industrielle (PSI). Par conséquent, les concepteurs-constructeurs qui prévoient présenter une proposition pour ce projet et qui ne détiennent pas activement l’attestation de sécurité identifiée ci-dessus devraient commencer immédiatement le processus de demande d’attestation de sécurité en faisant la demande par l’intermédiaire du PSI de CDC.\r\nDans le cadre de ce programme, CDC peut, à son entière discrétion, fournir une aide préliminaire aux soumissionnaires potentiels pour le processus de parrainage visant l’obtention d’une attestation de sécurité.\r\nPour commencer ce processus, veuillez présenter une demande de parrainage à CDC en suivant les étapes suivantes qui se trouvent sur son site Web à : https://www.cdc-dcc.gc.ca/industrie/exigences-de-sécurité.\r\nDans la demande de parrainage qu’ils présentent à CDC, les experts-conseils ou entrepreneurs ou sont priés de notamment indiquer les renseignements suivants :\r\n\r\n\r\n\tLe numéro du préavis d’approvisionnement, tel qu’indiqué à la section 2 de ce PA;\r\n\tLe niveau de cote de sécurité demandé dans le cadre du parrainage, tel qu’indiqué à la section 3 de ce PA.\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\n\tProcessus de parrainage\r\n\r\n\r\nÀ la réception d’une demande de parrainage, CDC l’examine et communique directement avec l’expert-conseil ou l’entrepreneur pour compléter le dossier.\r\nUne fois que CDC a déterminé, à son entière discrétion, qu’un expert-conseil ou entrepreneur :\r\n\r\n\r\n\ta débuté le processus de parrainage avant que la sollicitation ne soit annoncée sur MERX;\r\n\ta satisfait à toutes les exigences matérielles de la trousse de demande de parrainage avant la date de fermeture indiquée dans la sollicitation;\r\n\ta déposé une proposition.\r\n\r\n\r\nCDC enverra la trousse de demande de parrainage au Programme de sécurité des contrats (PSC) de Services publics et Approvisionnement Canada (SPAC).\r\nRemarque : Les entrepreneurs ou experts-conseils qui ne transmettent pas de proposition ne pourront pas obtenir d’attestation de sécurité dans le cadre de ce processus de parrainage.\r\n\r\nAprès la réception du dossier de demande de parrainage, le PSC communique directement avec le soumissionnaire pour lui indiquer les prochaines étapes, les mesures à prendre ou l’état du traitement du dossier.         "tenderDescription-descriptionAppelOffres-eng": "Request for Information (RFI) for Application Performance Management 2 (APM2) SolutionThe Government of Canada (GC) is seeking to modernize and optimize the Application Performance Management (APM) enterprise observability platform used to monitor the health and performance of GC IT infrastructure, application and datacentre observability. This Request for Information (RFI) aims to gather comprehensive insight from industry on all viable infrastructure and application performance observability platform solutions that support the continuous monitoring and tracking of infrastructure and application availability and performance while providing deeper ad-hoc visibility for diagnoses.The GC is seeking industry input on the current and emerging landscape with a view of informing future procurement strategies.  The objective is to establish procurement vehicle(s) that provide access to IT observability platform solutions and supporting services, to meet the Government’s diverse operational and security requirements.Through this initiative, the GC seeks to reduce risk, increase agility, and ensure long-term availability and performance of its IT infrastructure and application through observability.Please refer to the RFI Documentation for instructions on how to submit a Response.Questions: Questions concerning this RFI must be directed to the Contracting Authority.\nSSC RFI for Application Performance Management 2 (APM2) Solution- Amendment 000",
        "tenderDescription-descriptionAppelOffres-fra": "Demande de renseignements (DDR) pour une solution de gestion du rendement des applications 2 (GRA2)Le gouvernement du Canada (GC) cherche à moderniser et à optimiser la plateforme d’observabilité d’entreprise pour la gestion du rendement des applications (GRA) qui est utilisée pour surveiller le bon fonctionnement et le rendement de l’observabilité de l’infrastructure, des applications et des centres de données de TI du GC. La présente demande de renseignements (DDR) vise à recueillir de l’information exhaustive auprès de l’industrie sur toutes les solutions viables de plateforme d’observabilité de l’infrastructure et du rendement des applications qui permettent d’effectuer la surveillance et le suivi continus de la disponibilité et du rendement de l’infrastructure et des applications, tout en offrant une visibilité ponctuelle plus approfondie à des fins de diagnostic.Le GC cherche à obtenir l’avis de l’industrie sur le paysage actuel et émergent en vue d’orienter les stratégies d’approvisionnement éventuelles. L’objectif consiste à mettre en place au moins un mécanisme d’approvisionnement qui offre un accès aux solutions de plateforme d’observabilité des TI et aux services de soutien afin de répondre aux diverses exigences fonctionnelles et en matière de sécurité du gouvernement.Avec cette initiative, le GC cherche à réduire les risques, accroître l’agilité et assurer la disponibilité et le rendement à long terme de son infrastructure de TI et de ses applications grâce à l’observabilité.Veuillez consulter la documentation de la DDR pour obtenir des instructions sur la façon de soumettre une réponse.Questions : Les questions concernant la présente DDR doivent être adressées à l’autorité contractante.\nSSC RFI for Application Performance Management 2 (APM2) Solution- Amendment 000"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Receive an exact Git source cache from captured GitData and existing sources.
MIT. The maintained builder remains the package/profile/runtime authority.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
from contextlib import ExitStack
import datetime as dt
import fcntl
import gzip
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import re
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import tarfile
import threading
import uuid
import zipfile
import zlib

SCHEMA = "stellar-forge.git-object-receiving.v1"
STATE_SCHEMA = "stellar-forge.git-object-cache.v1"
TRANSFER_SCHEMA = "stellar-forge.git-source-transfer.v1"
PART_SCHEMA = "stellar-forge.git-source-part.v1"
OID = re.compile(r"^[a-f0-9]{40}$")
FILE_LIMIT = 2 * 1024 * 1024
SOURCE_LIMIT = 128 * 1024 * 1024
METADATA_LIMIT = 8 * 1024 * 1024
COMPRESSED_ARCHIVE_LIMIT = 64 * 1024 * 1024
# Payload plus bounded tar headers, padding and skipped original members.
ARCHIVE_STREAM_LIMIT = 256 * 1024 * 1024

class SourceError(Exception):
    pass

def need(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise SourceError(message)

def now():
    return dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat()

def object_id(kind, data):
    return hashlib.sha1(f"{kind} {len(data)}\0".encode("ascii") + data).hexdigest()

def canonical(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False) + "\n").encode("utf-8")

def regular(path, maximum=FILE_LIMIT, executable=None):
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        before = os.fstat(fd)
        need(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and before.st_size <= maximum, "Expected a bounded regular source file")
        if executable is not None:
            need(bool(before.st_mode & stat.S_IXUSR) == executable,
                 "Existing materialized source executable mode differs: " + str(path))
        with os.fdopen(fd, "rb", closefd=False) as handle:
            data = handle.read(maximum + 1)
        after = os.fstat(fd)
        need(len(data) == before.st_size and (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns, before.st_mode) ==
             (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns, after.st_mode), "Source file changed during reading")
        return data
    finally:
        os.close(fd)

def absolute_directory(value, exists=True):
    path = Path(value)
    need(path.is_absolute() and str(path) == str(path.absolute()), "Use an absolute source/cache directory")
    need(path.resolve(strict=exists) == path, "Source/cache directories must retain their canonical path")
    if exists:
        need(stat.S_ISDIR(path.lstat().st_mode), "Expected an existing source/cache directory")
    return path

def json_file(path, maximum=METADATA_LIMIT):
    data = regular(path, maximum)
    if data.startswith(b"\x1f\x8b"):
        decoder = zlib.decompressobj(31)
        data = decoder.decompress(data, maximum + 1)
        need(len(data) <= maximum and decoder.eof and not decoder.unused_data and not decoder.unconsumed_tail,
             "Compressed source metadata exceeds its original bounded size")
    return json.loads(data)

def atomic_json(path, value):
    data = canonical(value)
    temporary = path.with_name(path.name + "." + uuid.uuid4().hex + ".receiving-tmp")
    fd = os.open(temporary, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb", closefd=False) as handle:
            handle.write(data)
            handle.flush()
            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    os.replace(temporary, path)

def validate_metadata(value):
    need(isinstance(value, dict) and value.get("schema") == SCHEMA, "Unsupported Git source receiving schema")
    source = value.get("source")
    tree = value.get("tree")
    commit_text = value.get("commitText")
    need(isinstance(source, dict) and OID.fullmatch(source.get("commit", "")) and
         OID.fullmatch(source.get("tree", "")), "Exact original commit and root tree IDs are required")
    need(isinstance(tree, dict) and tree.get("sha") == source["tree"] and tree.get("truncated") is False and
         isinstance(tree.get("tree"), list), "The complete original recursive tree is required")
    need(isinstance(commit_text, str), "Original commit bytes are required as UTF-8 commitText")
    commit = commit_text.encode("utf-8")
    need(object_id("commit", commit) == source["commit"], "Original Git commit object hash does not match")
    need(commit_text.split("\n", 1)[0] == "tree " + source["tree"], "Commit and recursive root tree differ")
    entries = {}
    groups = {"": []}
    expected_trees = {"": source["tree"]}
    for row in tree["tree"]:
        need(isinstance(row, dict), "Invalid recursive tree row")
        path, mode, kind, oid = (row.get(k) for k in ("path", "mode", "type", "sha"))
        need(isinstance(path, str) and path and "\0" not in path and not path.startswith("/") and
             all(part not in ("", ".", "..") for part in path.split("/")), "Invalid original Git path")
        need(path not in entries and OID.fullmatch(oid or ""), "Duplicate path or invalid original object ID")
        need((kind, mode) in (("tree", "040000"), ("blob", "100644"), ("blob", "100755"),
                              ("blob", "120000"), ("commit", "160000")), "Unsupported original Git tree mode/type")
        entries[path] = row
        parent, _, name = path.rpartition("/")
        groups.setdefault(parent, []).append((name, row))
        if kind == "tree":
            expected_trees[path] = oid
            groups.setdefault(path, [])
    need(set(groups) == set(expected_trees), "Recursive tree omits an intermediate tree")
    objects = []
    for path, rows in groups.items():
        rows.sort(key=lambda item: (item[0] + ("/" if item[1]["type"] == "tree" else "")).encode("utf-8"))
        body = b"".join(
            (row["mode"].lstrip("0") + " " + name).encode("utf-8") + b"\0" + bytes.fromhex(row["sha"])
            for name, row in rows
        )
        need(object_id("tree", body) == expected_trees[path], "Original Git tree object hash does not match: " + path)
        objects.append((expected_trees[path], "tree", body))
    required = value.get("requiredPaths")
    need(isinstance(required, list) and required and len(required) == len(set(required)),
         "Original required source paths must be a nonempty unique list")
    selected = []
    for path in required:
        row = entries.get(path)
        need(row and row["type"] == "blob" and row["mode"] in ("100644", "100755"),
             "Only an original regular source path can be received: " + str(path))
        need(isinstance(row.get("size"), int) and 0 <= row["size"] <= FILE_LIMIT, "Source file exceeds its original limit")
        selected.append(row)
    need(sum(row["size"] for row in selected) <= SOURCE_LIMIT, "Required source exceeds the maintained 128 MiB budget")
    objects.append((source["commit"], "commit", commit))
    return source, entries, selected, objects

def git_command(git, repository, args, **options):
    environment = dict(os.environ, GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT="0")
    return subprocess.run(
        [git, "--no-replace-objects", "--no-lazy-fetch", "-C", str(repository), *args],
        shell=False, env=environment, **options
    )

class ObjectCache:
    def __init__(self, repository):
        self.repository = repository
        self.written = 0
        self.raw_bytes = 0

    def path(self, oid):
        need(OID.fullmatch(oid) is not None, "Invalid Git object ID")
        return self.repository / "objects" / oid[:2] / oid[2:]

    def read(self, oid, expected_kind=None):
        path = self.path(oid)
        if not path.exists():
            return None
        compressed = regular(path, FILE_LIMIT + 1024 * 1024)
        decoder = zlib.decompressobj()
        raw = decoder.decompress(compressed, FILE_LIMIT + 1024 * 1024)
        need(decoder.eof and not decoder.unused_data and not decoder.unconsumed_tail, "Git object exceeds its bounded original size")
        head, body = raw.split(b"\0", 1)
        kind, size = head.decode("ascii").split(" ")
        need(size == str(len(body)) and object_id(kind, body) == oid, "Cached original Git object changed")
        need(expected_kind is None or kind == expected_kind, "Cached Git object has the wrong type")
        return body

    def write(self, oid, kind, body):
        need(object_id(kind, body) == oid, "Received bytes do not match the original Git object")
        path = self.path(oid)
        path.parent.mkdir(mode=0o700, exist_ok=True)
        if path.exists():
            need(self.read(oid, kind) == body, "Existing immutable Git object differs")
            return False
        raw = f"{kind} {len(body)}\0".encode("ascii") + body
        compressed = zlib.compress(raw)
        temporary = path.parent / ("tmp_obj_" + uuid.uuid4().hex + ".receiving")
        fd = os.open(temporary, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
        try:
            with os.fdopen(fd, "wb", closefd=False) as handle:
                handle.write(compressed)
                handle.flush()
                os.fsync(handle.fileno())
            try:
                os.link(temporary, path, follow_symlinks=False)
            except FileExistsError:
                need(self.read(oid, kind) == body, "Concurrent immutable Git object differs")
                return False
        finally:
            os.close(fd)
            temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        self.written += 1
        self.raw_bytes += len(body)
        return True

def receive_git_donor(git, donor, cache, missing):
    """Read batches from an existing object database; never fetch or alter it."""
    ids = list(missing)
    if not ids:
        return 0
    inspected = git_command(git, donor, ["cat-file", "--batch-check"],
                            input=("\n".join(ids) + "\n").encode("ascii"),
                            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=60)
    need(inspected.returncode == 0, "Existing Git donor metadata read failed (exit " + str(inspected.returncode) + ")")
    lines = inspected.stdout.decode("ascii").splitlines()
    need(len(lines) == len(ids), "Incomplete original Git donor metadata batch")
    available = []
    for oid, line in zip(ids, lines):
        fields = line.split(" ")
        need(fields[0] == oid, "Original Git donor metadata order changed")
        if fields[1:] == ["missing"]:
            continue
        need(len(fields) == 3 and fields[1] == "blob" and int(fields[2]) == missing[oid]["size"],
             "Original Git donor object metadata differs")
        available.append(oid)
    if not available:
        return 0
    environment = dict(os.environ, GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT="0")
    process = subprocess.Popen(
        [git, "--no-replace-objects", "--no-lazy-fetch", "-C", str(donor), "cat-file", "--batch"],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, env=environment, shell=False
    )
    send_error = []
    def send():
        try:
            process.stdin.write(("\n".join(available) + "\n").encode("ascii"))
            process.stdin.close()
        except BaseException as error:
            send_error.append(type(error).__name__)
    sender = threading.Thread(target=send, daemon=True)
    sender.start()
    received = 0
    try:
        for oid in available:
            header = process.stdout.readline(160).decode("ascii").rstrip("\n").split(" ")
            need(len(header) == 3 and header[0] == oid and header[1] == "blob" and
                 int(header[2]) == missing[oid]["size"], "Original donor content header changed")
            size = int(header[2])
            body = process.stdout.read(size)
            need(len(body) == size and process.stdout.read(1) == b"\n", "Original donor content was truncated")
            cache.write(oid, "blob", body)
            del missing[oid]
            received += 1
        need(process.stdout.read(1) == b"", "Unexpected extra original donor content")
        sender.join(timeout=10)
        need(not sender.is_alive() and not send_error and process.wait(timeout=10) == 0, "Original donor batch did not finish")
        return received
    finally:
        if process.poll() is None:
            process.terminate()
            try:
                process.wait(timeout=10)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                process.kill()
                process.wait(timeout=10)
        process.stdout.close()
        if not process.stdin.closed:
            process.stdin.close()

def receive_files(directory, selected, cache, missing, flat=False):
    received = 0
    for row in selected:
        oid = row["sha"]
        if oid not in missing:
            continue
        path = directory / (oid + ".blob") if flat else directory / row["path"]
        compressed_path = directory / (oid + ".blob.gz") if flat else None
        try:
            if compressed_path is not None and compressed_path.exists():
                packed = regular(compressed_path, FILE_LIMIT + 65536)
                decoder = zlib.decompressobj(31)
                data = decoder.decompress(packed, FILE_LIMIT + 1)
                need(len(data) <= FILE_LIMIT and decoder.eof and not decoder.unused_data and not decoder.unconsumed_tail,
                     "Received compressed blob exceeds its original source limit")
            else:
                data = regular(path)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            continue
        except OSError as error:
            if error.errno == 40:  # O_NOFOLLOW rejects source aliases.
                continue
            raise
        if len(data) != row["size"] or object_id("blob", data) != oid:
            continue
        cache.write(oid, "blob", data)
        del missing[oid]
        received += 1
    return received

class ArchiveStream:
    """Limit expanded tar bytes, including names, headers and skipped members."""
    def __init__(self, source):
        self.source = source
        self.bytes = 0

    def read(self, size=-1):
        remaining = ARCHIVE_STREAM_LIMIT - self.bytes
        requested = remaining + 1 if size is None or size < 0 else min(size, remaining + 1)
        data = self.source.read(min(requested, 65536))
        self.bytes += len(data)
        need(self.bytes <= ARCHIVE_STREAM_LIMIT, "Expanded source archive exceeds 256 MiB")
        return data

def receive_archive(expected_sha256, filename, cache, missing):
    """Read exact blobs directly from an existing pinned tar.gz release."""
    need(re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9]{64}", expected_sha256 or "") is not None,
         "An original archive SHA-256 is required")
    path = Path(filename)
    need(path.is_absolute() and path.resolve(strict=True) == path,
         "Use the original absolute regular archive path")
    need(stat.S_ISREG(path.lstat().st_mode), "Source archive must be a regular file")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    with os.fdopen(fd, "rb") as stream:
        before = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
        need(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and before.st_size <= COMPRESSED_ARCHIVE_LIMIT,
             "Compressed source archive exceeds 64 MiB")
        digest = hashlib.sha256()
        hashed_bytes = 0
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            hashed_bytes += len(block)
            need(hashed_bytes <= before.st_size, "Original source archive grew during hashing")
            digest.update(block)
        need(hashed_bytes == before.st_size, "Original source archive changed during hashing")
        need(digest.hexdigest() == expected_sha256, "Original source archive digest differs")
        stream.seek(0)
        sizes = {row["size"] for row in missing.values()}
        received = 0
        regular_members = 0
        with gzip.GzipFile(fileobj=stream, mode="rb") as expanded:
            bounded = ArchiveStream(expanded)
            with tarfile.open(fileobj=bounded, mode="r|") as archive:
                for member in archive:
                    # Names and link targets never become filesystem paths.
                    if not member.isfile():
                        continue
                    regular_members += 1
                    need(member.size >= 0, "Negative original archive member size")
                    if not missing or member.size not in sizes or member.size > FILE_LIMIT:
                        continue
                    handle = archive.extractfile(member)
                    need(handle is not None, "Original archive member could not be read")
                    with handle:
                        data = handle.read(FILE_LIMIT + 1)
                    need(len(data) == member.size, "Original archive member was truncated")
                    oid = object_id("blob", data)
                    row = missing.get(oid)
                    if row is None or row["size"] != len(data):
                        continue
                    cache.write(oid, "blob", data)
                    del missing[oid]
                    received += 1
            # Consume the original compressed member through its checksum even
            # after tar's end marker, without retaining expanded bytes.
            while bounded.read(65536):
                pass
        after = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
        need((before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==
             (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns),
             "Original source archive changed during reading")
    return {"kind": "original-release-archive", "archive": str(path),
            "sha256": expected_sha256, "archiveBytes": before.st_size,
            "expandedBytes": bounded.bytes, "regularMembers": regular_members,
            "objects": received}

def bounded_integer(value, maximum, label, minimum=0):
    need(type(value) is int and minimum <= value <= maximum, "Invalid " + label)
    return value

def source_path(value):
    need(isinstance(value, str) and value and "\0" not in value and "\\" not in value and
         not value.startswith("/") and all(part not in ("", ".", "..") for part in value.split("/")),
         "Source transfer requires a relative POSIX path")
    return value

def source_file_state(value):
    return (value.st_dev, value.st_ino, value.st_size, value.st_mtime_ns, value.st_ctime_ns)

def carrier_tree(files):
    """Reconstruct the carrier root without creating archive member paths."""
    groups = {"": {}}
    for path, (mode, oid) in files.items():
        source_path(path)
        parts = path.split("/")
        for depth in range(1, len(parts)):
            groups.setdefault("/".join(parts[:depth]), {})
        parent, _, name = path.rpartition("/")
        need(name not in groups[parent], "Duplicate source carrier entry")
        groups[parent][name] = (mode, oid)
    roots = {}
    for parent in sorted(groups, key=lambda path: (path.count("/"), len(path)), reverse=True):
        rows = groups[parent]
        body = b"".join(
            (mode.lstrip("0") + " " + name).encode("utf-8") + b"\0" + bytes.fromhex(oid)
            for name, (mode, oid) in sorted(
                rows.items(), key=lambda item: (item[0] + ("/" if item[1][0] == "040000" else "")).encode("utf-8"))
        )
        roots[parent] = object_id("tree", body)
        if parent:
            ancestor, _, name = parent.rpartition("/")
            need(name not in groups[ancestor], "Source carrier path is both a file and a directory")
            groups[ancestor][name] = ("040000", roots[parent])
    return roots[""]

def github_commit_text(commit, source):
    need(isinstance(commit, dict) and commit.get("sha") == source["commit"] and
         isinstance(commit.get("tree"), dict) and commit["tree"].get("sha") == source["tree"],
         "Original Git commit authority differs from the selected source")
    candidates = []
    if isinstance(commit.get("commitText"), str):
        candidates.append(commit["commitText"])
    verification = commit.get("verification")
    if isinstance(verification, dict) and isinstance(verification.get("payload"), str):
        payload = verification["payload"]
        signature = verification.get("signature")
        if isinstance(signature, str) and signature:
            head, separator, message = payload.partition("\n\n")
            need(separator and "\ngpgsig " not in head, "Malformed original signed commit payload")
            # GitHub retains a final signature newline as a blank continuation
            # line. Preserve it; accept a normalized variant only by original SHA.
            for exact_signature in dict.fromkeys((signature, signature.removesuffix("\n"))):
                candidates.append(head + "\ngpgsig " + exact_signature.replace("\n", "\n ") +
                                  "\n\n" + message)
        else:
            candidates.append(payload)
    for candidate in candidates:
        if object_id("commit", candidate.encode("utf-8")) == source["commit"]:
            return candidate
    raise SourceError("Original commit bytes are unavailable: capture exact commitText or the original signed GitHub payload")

class SourcePart:
    """One pinned ZIP; member names remain in memory and never become paths."""
    def __init__(self, stack, directory, record, source, count):
        self.record = record
        relative = source_path(record.get("path"))
        path = directory / relative
        need(path.resolve(strict=True) == path, "Source part path must retain its canonical location")
        fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
        self.stream = stack.enter_context(os.fdopen(fd, "rb"))
        self.path = path
        self.before = os.fstat(fd)
        expected_bytes = bounded_integer(record.get("archiveBytes"), COMPRESSED_ARCHIVE_LIMIT,
                                         "source ZIP byte length", minimum=1)
        need(stat.S_ISREG(self.before.st_mode) and self.before.st_size == expected_bytes,
             "Source ZIP size differs from the captured transfer")
        digest = hashlib.sha256()
        consumed = 0
        for block in iter(lambda: self.stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            consumed += len(block)
            need(consumed <= expected_bytes, "Source ZIP grew during hashing")
            digest.update(block)
        need(consumed == expected_bytes, "Source ZIP was truncated during hashing")
        self.sha256 = digest.hexdigest()
        if record.get("archiveSha256") is not None:
            need(record["archiveSha256"] == self.sha256, "Source ZIP digest differs from its pinned receipt")
        self.unchanged()
        self.stream.seek(0)
        self.archive = stack.enter_context(zipfile.ZipFile(self.stream, mode="r"))
        items = self.archive.infolist()
        need(1 <= len(items) <= 50000, "Source ZIP has an invalid member count")
        names = set()
        roots = set()
        self.files = {}
        directories = set()
        expanded_bytes = 0
        for item in items:
            need(item.orig_filename == item.filename and "\0" not in item.filename,
                 "Source ZIP member name was truncated")
            name = item.filename.removesuffix("/") if item.is_dir() else item.filename
            source_path(name)
            need(item.filename not in names and not item.flag_bits & 1,
                 "Source ZIP contains duplicate or encrypted members")
            names.add(item.filename)
            need(item.compress_type in (zipfile.ZIP_STORED, zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED),
                 "Unsupported source ZIP compression")
            expanded_bytes += item.file_size
            need(item.file_size >= 0 and expanded_bytes <= SOURCE_LIMIT + METADATA_LIMIT,
                 "Expanded source ZIP exceeds the original source budget")
            wrapper, separator, member = name.partition("/")
            roots.add(wrapper)
            mode = item.external_attr >> 16
            kind = stat.S_IFMT(mode)
            if item.is_dir():
                need(kind in (0, stat.S_IFDIR) and item.file_size == 0, "Source ZIP directory changed type")
                directories.add(member if separator else "")
                continue
            need(separator and member and kind in (0, stat.S_IFREG),
                 "Source ZIP must contain regular files under one wrapper directory")
            need(member not in self.files, "Duplicate normalized source ZIP path")
            self.files[member] = item
        need(len(roots) == 1 and "SOURCE-PART.json" in self.files,
             "Source ZIP requires one original carrier wrapper and manifest")
        allowed_directories = {""}
        for name in self.files:
            components = name.split("/")
            allowed_directories.update("/".join(components[:depth]) for depth in range(1, len(components)))
        need(directories <= allowed_directories, "Source ZIP contains undeclared directory entries")
        manifest_size = bounded_integer(record.get("manifestBytes"), METADATA_LIMIT, "source manifest size", minimum=1)
        raw = self.read("SOURCE-PART.json", manifest_size, METADATA_LIMIT, "100644")
        need(object_id("blob", raw) == record["manifestGitBlob"] and
             hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == record["manifestSha256"],
             "Source part manifest differs from the captured Git object")
        self.manifest = json.loads(raw)
        manifest = self.manifest
        need(isinstance(manifest, dict) and manifest.get("schema") == PART_SCHEMA and
             manifest.get("source") == source and manifest.get("part") == record["part"] and
             manifest.get("parts") == count and manifest.get("kind") == record["kind"] and
             isinstance(manifest.get("members"), list), "Source part belongs to a different original transfer")
        self.carrier_files = {"SOURCE-PART.json": ("100644", record["manifestGitBlob"])}
        self.authorities = {}
        expected_files = {"SOURCE-PART.json"}
        if record["kind"] == "git-authority":
            need(manifest["members"] == [] and isinstance(manifest.get("authorities"), list) and
                 len(manifest["authorities"]) == 2, "Original source authority part is incomplete")
            expected_authorities = {"SOURCE-COMMIT.json": "github-git-commit-response",
                                    "SOURCE-TREE.json": "github-recursive-git-tree-response"}
            for authority in manifest["authorities"]:
                need(isinstance(authority, dict), "Malformed source authority")
                name = authority.get("path")
                need(name in expected_authorities and name not in self.authorities and
                     authority.get("kind") == expected_authorities[name], "Unexpected source authority")
                size = bounded_integer(authority.get("bytes"), METADATA_LIMIT, "source authority size", minimum=1)
                body = self.read(name, size, METADATA_LIMIT, "100644")
                need(hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest() == authority.get("sha256"), "Original source authority digest differs")
                self.authorities[name] = json.loads(body)
                self.carrier_files[name] = ("100644", object_id("blob", body))
                expected_files.add(name)
        else:
            need(not manifest.get("authorities"), "Source data part cannot replace original authority")
            for member in manifest["members"]:
                need(isinstance(member, dict), "Malformed original source member")
                name = source_path(member.get("path"))
                need(name not in expected_files and member.get("mode") in ("100644", "100755") and
                     isinstance(member.get("gitBlob"), str) and OID.fullmatch(member["gitBlob"]),
                     "Duplicate or unsupported original source member")
                bounded_integer(member.get("bytes"), FILE_LIMIT, "original source member size")
                expected_files.add(name)
                self.carrier_files[name] = (member["mode"], member["gitBlob"])
        need(set(self.files) == expected_files, "Source ZIP file membership differs from its manifest")
        need(carrier_tree(self.carrier_files) == record["carrierTree"], "Source carrier Git tree differs")
        need(record["sourceFiles"] == len(manifest["members"]) and
             record["sourceBytes"] == sum(member["bytes"] for member in manifest["members"]),
             "Source part totals differ from the transfer index")

    def unchanged(self):
        need(source_file_state(self.before) == source_file_state(os.fstat(self.stream.fileno())),
             "Source ZIP changed while it was being received")

    def read(self, name, expected_size, maximum, mode):
        item = self.files.get(name)
        need(item is not None and item.file_size == expected_size and expected_size <= maximum,
             "Source ZIP member size differs: " + name)
        unix_mode = item.external_attr >> 16
        if item.create_system == 3 and unix_mode:
            need(stat.S_IMODE(unix_mode) == (0o755 if mode == "100755" else 0o644),
                 "Source ZIP executable mode differs: " + name)
        with self.archive.open(item, mode="r") as stream:
            body = stream.read(maximum + 1)
        need(len(body) == expected_size, "Source ZIP member was truncated: " + name)
        return body

    def receive(self, cache, missing):
        count = 0
        for member in self.manifest["members"]:
            body = self.read(member["path"], member["bytes"], FILE_LIMIT, member["mode"])
            oid = member["gitBlob"]
            need(object_id("blob", body) == oid, "Source ZIP bytes differ from original Git object: " + member["path"])
            if cache.write(oid, "blob", body):
                count += 1
            missing.pop(oid, None)
        self.unchanged()
        return {"part": self.record["part"], "kind": self.record["kind"],
                "archive": str(self.path), "archiveBytes": self.before.st_size, "sha256": self.sha256,
                "carrierCommit": self.record["carrierCommit"], "carrierTree": self.record["carrierTree"],
                "manifestGitBlob": self.record["manifestGitBlob"],
                "sourceFiles": self.record["sourceFiles"], "sourceBytes": self.record["sourceBytes"],
                "objects": count, "phase": "OBJECTS_RECEIVED"}

class SourceTransfer:
    def __init__(self, filename, *, commit_text=None):
        self.stack = ExitStack()
        try:
            index_path = Path(filename)
            need(index_path.is_absolute() and index_path.resolve(strict=True) == index_path,
                 "Use the original absolute source transfer index path")
            index_bytes = regular(index_path, METADATA_LIMIT)
            self.index = json.loads(index_bytes)
            index = self.index
            need(isinstance(index, dict) and index.get("schema") == TRANSFER_SCHEMA,
                 "Unsupported source transfer index schema")
            source = index.get("source")
            records = index.get("parts")
            need(isinstance(source, dict) and isinstance(source.get("repository"), str) and
                 re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+", source["repository"]) and
                 isinstance(source.get("commit"), str) and OID.fullmatch(source["commit"]) and
                 isinstance(source.get("tree"), str) and OID.fullmatch(source["tree"]),
                 "Source transfer requires the exact original repository, commit and tree")
            bounded_integer(source.get("fileCount"), 50000, "original source file count", minimum=1)
            bounded_integer(source.get("sourceBytes"), SOURCE_LIMIT, "original source byte count")
            need(isinstance(records, list) and 1 <= len(records) <= 1000,
                 "Source transfer requires its complete part index")
            paths = set()
            for number, record in enumerate(records, 1):
                need(isinstance(record, dict) and type(record.get("part")) is int and record["part"] == number and
                     record.get("kind") in ("git-authority", "source-files"), "Source transfer parts must be contiguous and ordered")
                name = source_path(record.get("path"))
                need(name not in paths, "Source transfer reuses an archive path")
                paths.add(name)
                for key in ("carrierCommit", "carrierTree", "manifestGitBlob"):
                    need(isinstance(record.get(key), str) and OID.fullmatch(record[key]),
                         "Source transfer requires an exact " + key)
                need(isinstance(record.get("manifestSha256"), str) and
                     re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9]{64}", record["manifestSha256"]),
                     "Source transfer requires the exact manifest SHA-256")
                bounded_integer(record.get("sourceFiles"), source["fileCount"], "source part file count")
                bounded_integer(record.get("sourceBytes"), source["sourceBytes"], "source part byte count")
            need(sum(record["kind"] == "git-authority" for record in records) == 1 and
                 records[0]["kind"] == "git-authority", "The first and only authority part must retain the original Git metadata")
            self.parts = [SourcePart(self.stack, index_path.parent, record, source, len(records)) for record in records]
            authority = self.parts[0].authorities
            tree = authority["SOURCE-TREE.json"]
            need(isinstance(tree, dict) and isinstance(tree.get("tree"), list), "Malformed original recursive source tree")
            rows = tree["tree"]
            regular_rows = [row for row in rows if isinstance(row, dict) and row.get("type") == "blob" and
                            row.get("mode") in ("100644", "100755")]
            need(all(isinstance(row, dict) and (row.get("type") == "tree" or
                     (row.get("type") == "blob" and row.get("mode") in ("100644", "100755"))) for row in rows),
                 "This source transfer must retain only original regular files and directories")
            need(len(regular_rows) == source["fileCount"] and
                 all(type(row.get("size")) is int and 0 <= row["size"] <= FILE_LIMIT for row in regular_rows) and
                 sum(row["size"] for row in regular_rows) == source["sourceBytes"],
                 "Complete original source totals differ from the transfer")
            commit_authority = authority["SOURCE-COMMIT.json"]
            if commit_text is not None:
                need(isinstance(commit_authority, dict) and isinstance(commit_text, str) and
                     object_id("commit", commit_text.encode("utf-8")) == source["commit"],
                     "The supplied original commit bytes differ from the selected source")
                commit_authority = {**commit_authority, "commitText": commit_text}
            self.metadata = {"schema": SCHEMA, "source": source, "tree": tree,
                             "commitText": github_commit_text(commit_authority, source),
                             "requiredPaths": [row["path"] for row in regular_rows]}
            _, entries, _, _ = validate_metadata(self.metadata)
            declared = set()
            for part in self.parts:
                for member in part.manifest["members"]:
                    path = member["path"]
                    row = entries.get(path)
                    need(path not in declared and row is not None and
                         (row["mode"], row["sha"], row.get("size")) ==
                         (member["mode"], member["gitBlob"], member["bytes"]),
                         "Source part duplicates or changes an original source path: " + path)
                    declared.add(path)
            need(declared == set(self.metadata["requiredPaths"]), "Source transfer omits original files")
            self.identity = hashlib.sha256(index_bytes).hexdigest()
        except BaseException:
            self.stack.close()
            raise

    def __enter__(self):
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *details):
        return self.stack.__exit__(*details)

def materialize(directory, selected, cache):
    directory = absolute_directory(directory, exists=False)
    directory.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    materialized = 0
    for row in selected:
        data = cache.read(row["sha"], "blob")
        need(data is not None, "Receive the complete requested closure before materializing it")
        path = directory / row["path"]
        path.parent.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        need(path.parent.resolve() == path.parent, "Materialized source directory was redirected")
        if path.exists():
            need(regular(path, executable=row["mode"] == "100755") == data,
                 "Existing source postimage differs: " + row["path"])
            continue
        temporary = path.with_name(".receiving-" + uuid.uuid4().hex)
        fd = os.open(temporary, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW,
                     0o755 if row["mode"] == "100755" else 0o644)
        try:
            os.fchmod(fd, 0o755 if row["mode"] == "100755" else 0o644)
            with os.fdopen(fd, "wb", closefd=False) as handle:
                handle.write(data)
                handle.flush()
                os.fsync(handle.fileno())
            try:
                os.link(temporary, path, follow_symlinks=False)
            except FileExistsError:
                need(regular(path, executable=row["mode"] == "100755") == data,
                     "Concurrent original source postimage differs")
        finally:
            os.close(fd)
            temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        materialized += 1
    return materialized

def receive_metadata(args, metadata, transfer=None):
    source, entries, selected, objects = validate_metadata(metadata)
    need(args.commit == source["commit"], "The explicit selected commit differs from the captured source")
    metadata_hash = hashlib.sha256(canonical(metadata)).hexdigest()
    directory = absolute_directory(args.directory, exists=False)
    directory.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    lock = os.open(directory / "source-receiving.lock", os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
    try:
        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        state_file = directory / "source-receiving.json"
        previous = json_file(state_file) if state_file.exists() else None
        if previous:
            need(previous.get("schema") == STATE_SCHEMA and previous.get("directory") == str(directory) and
                 previous.get("source") == source and previous.get("metadataSha256") == metadata_hash,
                 "Resume the original cache with its exact original source metadata")
        else:
            need(not any(p.name != "source-receiving.lock" for p in directory.iterdir()),
                 "Create an owned cache directory or resume its original receiving record")
            previous = {"schema": STATE_SCHEMA, "directory": str(directory), "source": source,
                        "metadataSha256": metadata_hash, "createdAt": now(), "phase": "RECEIVING"}
            atomic_json(state_file, previous)
        if transfer is not None:
            retained = previous.get("sourceTransfer")
            need(retained is None or (isinstance(retained, dict) and
                 retained.get("schema") == TRANSFER_SCHEMA and retained.get("indexSha256") == transfer.identity),
                 "Resume this source cache with its original transfer index")
            previous["sourceTransfer"] = retained or {"schema": TRANSFER_SCHEMA,
                "indexSha256": transfer.identity, "source": source, "parts": []}
            atomic_json(state_file, previous)
        repository = directory / "repository.git"
        if not repository.exists():
            started = subprocess.run([args.git, "init", "--bare", "--quiet", str(repository)],
                                     stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, shell=False, timeout=30)
            need(started.returncode == 0, "Could not initialize the owned Git object cache")
        additional = list(dict.fromkeys([*(previous.get("additionalPaths") or []), *args.additional_path]))
        selected_paths = {row["path"] for row in selected}
        for path in additional:
            row = entries.get(path)
            need(row and row["type"] == "blob" and row["mode"] in ("100644", "100755") and
                 isinstance(row.get("size"), int) and 0 <= row["size"] <= FILE_LIMIT,
                 "Additional closure path must be an original regular source file")
            if path not in selected_paths:
                selected.append(row)
                selected_paths.add(path)
        need(sum(row["size"] for row in selected) <= SOURCE_LIMIT, "Expanded source exceeds the maintained 128 MiB budget")
        cache = ObjectCache(repository)
        # Interrupted writes leave only our unreferenced temporary objects.
        for temporary in (repository / "objects").glob("??/tmp_obj_*.receiving"):
            need(stat.S_ISREG(temporary.lstat().st_mode), "Interrupted source temporary changed type")
            temporary.unlink()
        for oid, kind, body in objects:
            cache.write(oid, kind, body)
        # This is a shallow object cache for one immutable commit, with full tree
        # metadata and the requested native source blobs. Its parents remain exact.
        (repository / "shallow").write_text(source["commit"] + "\n", encoding="ascii")
        updated = git_command(args.git, repository, ["update-ref", "refs/heads/source", source["commit"]],
                              stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=30)
        need(updated.returncode == 0, "The owned Git cache requires Git with --no-lazy-fetch support")
        missing = {}
        for row in selected:
            if cache.read(row["sha"], "blob") is None:
                missing[row["sha"]] = {"sha": row["sha"], "size": row["size"], "paths": []}
        for row in selected:
            if row["sha"] in missing:
                missing[row["sha"]]["paths"].append(row["path"])
        donors = []
        for name in args.donor_repository:
            donor = absolute_directory(name)
            count = receive_git_donor(args.git, donor, cache, missing)
            donors.append({"kind": "original-git", "directory": str(donor), "objects": count})
        for name in args.donor_source:
            donor = absolute_directory(name)
            count = receive_files(donor, selected, cache, missing)
            donors.append({"kind": "original-source", "directory": str(donor), "objects": count})
        for expected_sha256, filename in getattr(args, "donor_archive", []):
            donors.append(receive_archive(expected_sha256, filename, cache, missing))
        for name in args.incoming:
            donor = absolute_directory(name)
            count = receive_files(donor, selected, cache, missing, flat=True)
            donors.append({"kind": "received-blobs", "directory": str(donor), "objects": count})
        if transfer is not None:
            retained_parts = {row["part"]: row for row in previous["sourceTransfer"]["parts"]}
            for part in transfer.parts:
                retained = retained_parts.get(part.record["part"])
                need(retained is None or retained.get("sha256") == part.sha256,
                     "Retain the original source archive bytes when resuming this transfer")
                receipt = part.receive(cache, missing)
                if retained is not None:
                    receipt["firstReceivedAt"] = retained["firstReceivedAt"]
                else:
                    receipt["firstReceivedAt"] = now()
                retained_parts[receipt["part"]] = receipt
                previous["sourceTransfer"]["parts"] = [retained_parts[number] for number in sorted(retained_parts)]
                previous["updatedAt"] = now()
                previous["phase"] = "RECEIVING"
                atomic_json(state_file, previous)
                donors.append({"kind": "source-transfer-part", "part": receipt["part"], "objects": receipt["objects"]})
        listed = git_command(args.git, repository, ["ls-tree", "-r", "-z", "--full-tree", source["commit"]],
                             stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=30)
        need(listed.returncode == 0, "Original Git could not enumerate the recovered source tree")
        actual = {}
        for line in listed.stdout.split(b"\0"):
            if not line:
                continue
            fields, path = line.split(b"\t", 1)
            mode, kind, oid = fields.decode("ascii").split(" ")
            actual[path.decode("utf-8")] = (mode, kind, oid)
        expected = {path: (row["mode"], row["type"], row["sha"])
                    for path, row in entries.items() if row["type"] != "tree"}
        need(actual == expected, "Git enumerated a different source tree")
        result = {**previous, "phase": "SOURCE_NEEDED" if missing else "OBJECTS_AVAILABLE",
                  "updatedAt": now(), "repository": str(repository), "gitTreeEntries": len(actual),
                  "verifiedTreeObjects": sum(kind == "tree" for _, kind, _ in objects),
                  "requiredPaths": len(selected), "requiredBytes": sum(row["size"] for row in selected),
                  "additionalPaths": additional,
                  "writtenObjects": cache.written, "writtenRawBytes": cache.raw_bytes, "donors": donors,
                  "missingObjects": len(missing), "missingBytes": sum(row["size"] for row in missing.values())}
        atomic_json(directory / "missing-objects.json", {"source": source, "objects": list(missing.values())})
        if args.materialize and not missing:
            result["materializedFiles"] = materialize(args.materialize, selected, cache)
            result["sourceDirectory"] = str(Path(args.materialize))
        atomic_json(state_file, result)
        print(json.dumps(result, separators=(",", ":")))
        return 2 if missing else 0
    finally:
        os.close(lock)

def receive(args):
    commit_text = None
    if getattr(args, "commit_text", None):
        need(args.source_transfer, "Use --commit-text with the original --source-transfer index")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Unpack or verify one original Starforge release without executing its source."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import re
import stat
import tarfile

SCHEMA = "stellar-forge.merchant-distribution-manifest.v1"
PACKAGE = "@tokenjunkielabs/starforge-merchant"
MAX_ARCHIVE = 64 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_SOURCE = 128 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_FILE = 4 * 1024 * 1024


def require(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise ValueError(message)


def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def relative_name(value):
    require(isinstance(value, str) and value and not value.startswith("/"), "Invalid release path")
    require(not any(ord(char) < 32 or ord(char) == 127 for char in value) and "\\" not in value,
            "Invalid release path")
    path = PurePosixPath(value)
    require(str(path) == value and all(part not in (".", "..", "") for part in path.parts),
            "Release paths must be normalized")
    return value


def inspect(archive, expected):
    info = archive.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and not archive.is_symlink() and info.st_size <= MAX_ARCHIVE,
            "Select a regular bounded original archive")
    require(re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", expected or ""), "Expected archive SHA-256 required")
    # The same open file is hashed and parsed, so swapping the pathname cannot
    # make extraction read a different file from the one whose digest matched.
    with archive.open("rb") as stream:
        digest = hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()
        require(digest == expected, "Original archive SHA-256 does not match")
        stream.seek(0)
        with tarfile.open(fileobj=stream, mode="r|gz") as tar:
            members = {}
            member_bytes = {}
            total = 0
            for member in tar:
                require(len(members) < 10000, "Release contains too many entries")
                name = relative_name(member.name.rstrip("/") if member.isdir() else member.name)
                require(name == "package" or name.startswith("package/"), "Unexpected archive root")
                require(name not in members, "Duplicate archive member")
                require(member.isdir() or member.isfile(), "Release links and special files are not supported")
                require(not member.sparse, "Sparse release members are not supported")
                require(0 <= member.size <= MAX_FILE, "Release member is too large")
                total += member.size
                require(total <= MAX_SOURCE, "Release exceeds the unpacked size limit")
                members[name] = member
                if member.isfile():
                    # Read each member while its compressed stream is current.
                    # These bytes are already needed by extraction below; keeping
                    # them here avoids a gzip rewind for every manifest lookup.
                    handle = tar.extractfile(member)
                    require(handle is not None, "Cannot read original release member")
                    with handle:
                        data = handle.read(member.size + 1)
                    require(len(data) == member.size, "Release member size changed")
                    member_bytes[name] = data

            def content(name):
                item = members.get(name)
                require(item is not None and item.isfile(), "Required original release file is missing: " + name)
                return member_bytes[name]

            manifest_bytes = content("package/manifest.json")
            manifest = json.loads(manifest_bytes)
            metadata = json.loads(content("package/package.json"))
            require(manifest.get("schema") == SCHEMA and manifest.get("packageName") == PACKAGE,
                    "Original merchant distribution manifest required")
            require(re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", manifest.get("sourceCommit", "")), "Invalid source commit")
            require(metadata.get("name") == PACKAGE and metadata.get("version") == manifest.get("packageVersion"),
                    "Package and source manifest identities differ")
            require(not metadata.get("scripts"), "Original source distribution must not contain install scripts")
            require(metadata.get("bin", {}).get("starforge") ==
                    "./source/stellar/scf-starforge-20261009/distribution/cli.mjs", "Original product entrypoint required")
            package_files = manifest.get("packageFiles")
            require(isinstance(package_files, dict) and set(package_files) == {"package.json", "README.md", "LICENSE"},
                    "Original package file map required")
            expected_files = {"manifest.json": (sha(manifest_bytes), len(manifest_bytes), 0o644)}
            for name, digest in package_files.items():
                require(re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", digest or ""), "Invalid package file hash")
                data = content("package/" + name)
                require(sha(data) == digest, "Original package file changed: " + name)
                expected_files[name] = (digest, len(data), 0o644)
            files = manifest.get("files")
            require(isinstance(files, list) and 0 < len(files) < 10000, "Original source file map required")
            for item in files:
                name = relative_name(item.get("packagePath"))
                source = relative_name(item.get("path"))
                require(name == "source/" + source and name not in expected_files, "Duplicate or mismatched source path")
                require(item.get("mode") in ("100644", "100755"), "Original source must be a regular file")
                require(isinstance(item.get("bytes"), int) and 0 <= item["bytes"] <= MAX_FILE, "Invalid source size")
                require(re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", item.get("sha256", "")), "Invalid source hash")
                data = content("package/" + name)
                require(len(data) == item["bytes"] and sha(data) == item["sha256"], "Original source changed: " + source)
                if item.get("gitBlob"):
                    blob = hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(data)).encode() + b"\0" + data).hexdigest()
                    require(blob == item["gitBlob"], "Source Git identity changed: " + source)
                expected_files[name] = (item["sha256"], len(data), 0o755 if item["mode"] == "100755" else 0o644)
            require({name[8:] for name, item in members.items() if item.isfile()} == set(expected_files),
                    "Archive contains files outside the original manifest")
            # Retain only verified bytes. Never call tar.extract/extractall, and
            # never copy owners, symlinks, devices or permission bits from tar.
            data = {name: content("package/" + name) for name in expected_files}
            return manifest, expected_files, data, sha(manifest_bytes)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--archive", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--verify", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    archive = Path(args.archive).absolute()
    target = Path(args.out).absolute()
    manifest, files, contents, manifest_sha = inspect(archive, args.sha256)
    if args.verify:
        require(target.is_dir() and not target.is_symlink(), "Original extracted package directory required")
        inventory = set()
        for directory, names, filenames in os.walk(target, followlinks=False):
            for name in names:
                folder = Path(directory) / name
                require(stat.S_ISDIR(folder.lstat().st_mode) and not folder.is_symlink(),
                        "Installed source contains a linked or special directory")
            for name in filenames:
                inventory.add(str((Path(directory) / name).relative_to(target)))
        require(inventory == set(files),
                "Installed source inventory differs from the archive")
    else:
        target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    for name, (digest, length, mode) in files.items():
        file = target / name
        if args.verify:
            info = file.lstat()
            require(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and not file.is_symlink() and info.st_size == length and
                    stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode) == mode,
                    "Installed source file differs: " + name)
            require(sha(file.read_bytes()) == digest, "Installed source bytes differ: " + name)
        else:
            file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=0o755)
            with file.open("xb") as output:
                output.write(contents[name])
            file.chmod(mode)
    print(json.dumps({"status": "SOURCE_VERIFIED" if args.verify else "SOURCE_UNPACKED",
                      "packageDirectory": str(target), "sourceRoot": str(target / "source"),
                      "packageName": manifest["packageName"], "packageVersion": manifest["packageVersion"],
                      "sourceCommit": manifest["sourceCommit"], "sourceFiles": len(manifest["files"]),
                      "manifestSha256": manifest_sha}, separators=(",", ":")))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main()
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, tarfile.TarError) as error:
        print(json.dumps({"error": str(error)}), file=__import__("sys").stderr)
        raise SystemExit(1)
